# DSH pure JSON utility (MIT)

`src/json-value.ts` contains the upstream pure JSON utility, with two attribution
comment lines prepended and no changes to the source body. It is not the DSH
host program and is not relicensed under the project's Apache-2.0 license.

- Original license SHA-256: `ebb4f09972aee8608be255debaf78451a68e95c290f55c240dec2ecfa16ea6be`.

The original MIT license text is in the adjacent `LICENSE` and must accompany
the utility in source and compiled distributions. This fixed utility keeps
design-file JSON semantics independent of a host's changing re-export paths.
